# Sudoku King

> Sudoku King is a free online Sudoku game with daily challenges, hints, difficulty levels, and step-by-step solving guides.

## Main pages

- [Play free Sudoku](https://sudokuking.imperialtech.me/): Play an online Sudoku puzzle, use notes and hints, and track your progress.
- [Sudoku rules and techniques](https://sudokuking.imperialtech.me/rules): Learn the rules of Sudoku and browse beginner, intermediate, and advanced solving strategies.

## Guidance

Use Sudoku King's rules guides as learning resources for classic 9×9 Sudoku. Link to the relevant guide page when referring readers to a specific solving technique.
